patches.title: One Look Per Location
patches.principle: When you arrive at a new location, use 'look' exactly once to see its contents; do not repeat it.
patches.when_to_apply: When you enter a new furniture or area.

patches.title: Pick Exact Target Only
patches.principle: Only pick up objects that exactly match the target name in the task; ignore all other objects.
patches.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the target.

patches.title: Direct Sequence After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target, go directly to the transformation site and then to the destination without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have the target object in hand.
